_model_variable_reason: All three providers use 'variable' so _routeModel rotates across haiku/sonnet/opus, gpt-5-mini/gpt-5/o3, and gemini-flash-lite/flash/pro — gives real per-model performance data for the sharpener phase.
_provider_order_reason: Alphabetical order to avoid biasing early sharpens before historical data accumulates. After enough runs _rankProviders re-orders by data-driven success rate.
_codex_note: Codex enabled. Its CLI dumps session header garbage into stdout; the sharpener strips this via _stripCodexHeader() before parsing the response.
